changes.problem: Fixture offsets and UInt8 property/index restricted legal routed/tag-width responses.
changes.resolution: Typed semantic locators decode NPDU routing and BACnet tags; UInt32 context serialization and ACK reference correlation replace fixture slices.

codec_constraints.constraint: Who-Is ordered optional device limits 0..4194303; routed NPDU headers decoded.
ReadProperty object identifier and unsigned property/optional index of 1..4 octets; mutation reencodes and repairs length.
ComplexACK service12: matching invoke, object, property and optional index; balanced context3 value container.
I-Am typed application ObjectIdentifier/Unsigned/Enumerated/Unsigned; Device type8, maxAPDU/vendor <=65535, segmentation0..3.
Error service12: matching invoke and two typed ENUMERATED values of 1..4 octets.
Reject/server-Abort: dynamic invoke/reason after routed NPDU, no service or trailing content.
One pending request per session; guards/actions remain metadata.

remaining_gaps.description: Only the named seven-message service profile is described. Segmentation, BBMD/foreign-device lifecycle, BACnet/SC and other services remain absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add versioned service models, real reference messages, matching parser/encoder capability and independent conformance checks before broadening the scope.

remaining_gaps.description: Concurrent invokes and arbitrary property-value interpretation remain outside scope.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Retain single-flight profile and opaque balanced tagged values.

remaining_gaps.description: generic_wire.json contains only ReadProperty and one exact ACK; it omits Who-Is/I-Am/Error/Reject/Abort and cannot express dynamic NPDU/LVT/optional-field behavior.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Extend the generic language and loader for the needed structures and response alternatives; do not replace missing services with fixed opaque payload or flip online to true.
